## Personality

Allan is a frank and cheerful young man who holds high ideals. Because of these traits, he is well-liked by people of all ages.

## History

Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with his wife while on their honeymoon, taking up his position as the new minister. During a tea visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), he and his wife were served a cake accidentally flavored with liniment, though his wife warmly comforted the mortified [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over the mistake. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) paid him a peaceful visit to celebrate tying for first place on the Island on her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan serves as a kind minister's wife and trusted confidante for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). They first form a bond when Mrs. Allan gracefully comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the young girl accidentally serves her a cake flavored with liniment during a tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Over time, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) seeks out Mrs. Allan to share her greatest achievements, such as tying for first place on the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations, and relies on her for comfort and guidance when navigating deep sorrow following Matthew's sudden death.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P34](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0034), +16 more_
